review_summary: Production tau uses per-goal shortest-path congestion DP and one lexicographic Hungarian before the existing Task-BR/PIBT/LaCAM pipeline. Core congestion, neighbor-count, commitment, integration and compatibility tests pass. Quick preserves the 47/77 success set and improves common-case first-solution time. No parallel planner, exact PairCost refinement, or benchmark-specific fallback was introduced. The known quick makespan and SOC regressions must be disclosed in the final report.
